title: 3Sum
description:
Find every distinct triple of values `[a, b, c]` taken from three different positions of `nums` with `a + b + c == 0`.

Write each triple in ascending order, and list the triples in lexicographic order. Don't repeat a triple even if it can be formed from different positions.

### Input
- Line 1: `nums`, space-separated integers.

### Output
One line per inner array, its integers separated by spaces.

### Constraints
- `3 <= nums.length <= 3000`
- `-10^5 <= nums[i] <= 10^5`

  (lines[i] || "").chomp

lines = STDIN.read.split("\n", -1)
nums = line(lines, 0).split.map { |x| x.to_i }
result = solve(nums)
puts result.map { |row| row.map { |v| v.to_s }.join(" ") }.join("\n")
starters.php:
<?php

function solve(array $nums): array {
    // Return the distinct zero-sum triples, each sorted, in lexicographic order.
    return [];
}

function line(array $lines, int $i): string {
    return rtrim($lines[$i] ?? "", "\r");
}

function readWords(string $s): array {
    return preg_split('/\s+/', trim($s), -1, PREG_SPLIT_NO_EMPTY);
}

$lines = explode("\n", stream_get_contents(STDIN));
$nums = array_map(fn($x) => intval($x), readWords(line($lines, 0)));
$result = solve($nums);
echo implode("\n", array_map(fn($row) => implode(" ", array_map(fn($v) => $v, $row)), $result)), "\n";
